\section{An em dash inside the same verbatim environment}

The environment below is the same kind of environment as the passing fixture
uses, and the flag in it is fine. The em dash is not. The exemption covers the
double hyphen only.

\begin{verbatim}
bash scripts/regression-baseline.sh --check
echo "an em dash — inside verbatim is still rejected"
\end{verbatim}

The linter must report unicode-dash for this file.
